Repo <repo>, branch design/opencode-plugin-adapter, checked out — do not create or switch branches. Commit on this branch; do not push, do not touch PRs or threads, do not merge — the leader does that. Write set: docs/spec-opencode-lifecycle.tex only; commit by explicit path. Every commit passes `make check` (read its full output).

Context: Copilot reviewed head 036a5da and found (two threads, spec line ~1235 and design-opencode-plugin.md ~2561): after LcCfWriteClaim, LcCfCrash before LcCfFinish, then LcTierBDispatch for the child overwrites the binding; LcCfBegin then LcCfReconcileClaimed treats the incomplete record as not live (binding names another delegation, record not complete) and aborts the fork skeleton and removes its record although the child's claim still names the fork's mission. LiveSpared misses it because liveAborted reuses the same binding-or-complete predicate. Copilot says this passes with all sixteen switches on.

Do, per the contract:
1. Reproduce on the exhaustive claim slices (claim, claim+, claim-u, claim+u as needed) with probcli -goal/-check_goal (state-schema predicates are guards; check invariants as negated goals). Record command, states, depth, trace.
2. Add an independent invariant, built from claimed and dMis/dOwn/dKind and the open-to-aborted transition, not from the liveness predicate. Show it catches the trace and LiveSpared does not.
3. Leader-decided fix: switch fixClaimLive. A fork record (dkFork, owned by c) whose skeleton's mission is the mission c's claim names is live, whatever binding names. Apply it everywhere the liveness predicate appears (reconcile, refuse, release, leaked/liveAborted ghosts). Check for unsoundness, e.g. a stale record surviving because a claim for the same mission existed before the record. If the fix is unsound, model Copilot's alternative as a fallback: in LcTierBDispatch, under the dispatch-pending lock, mark a matching incomplete record complete before overwriting the binding. Report both; do not pick silently.
4. With the fix on, re-run every invariant (including WellFormed with the full goal) on every exhaustive slice, plus the new invariant. Record the counterexample with the switch off. Kill a mutant per new fix. Update the ledger (C17), consequences (the design sections that must change), limits, the results table, the commands block (the switch loop must list all seventeen switches), and every switch/counterexample count.
Submit the result with `ethos mission result` as before, then report: commit hashes, figures, and whether the fix held or the fallback was needed.
